dedupe_keys.name: gcp cem global carbon project cement process co2 emissions and clinker production dataset 1880 2025

description: GCP-CEM gives national CO2 process emissions from clinker production, the carbonate decomposition part of cement emissions, for 1880 to 2025, together with an annual clinker production dataset by country. The Zenodo record says process emissions were about 1.5 Gt CO2 in 2025, fuel combustion for cement heat is excluded, Annex I values come from UNFCCC reporting tables, clinker data come from national reports, BTR tables and official websites with a source for every value, and the August 2026 release adds new UNFCCC submissions and the separate annual cement production data. It is maintained by Robbie Andrew of the CICERO Center for International Climate Research for the Global Carbon Project under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as CSV and Excel files. Coverage is global, though not every country is present. Caveats: blank cells mean no data, New Zealand withholds clinker data, and non-Annex I emissions are estimated. For simulation it gives national clinker output and process emissions to calibrate cement sector energy, decarbonisation and supply models. Related catalogue records include the annual global cement production data and Climate TRACE.
